title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1971-02-21
lineage: SBD > Dolby A Reel > Dolby A decode > DAT > Sound Forge NR > CD-R

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a high‑energy Portchester run with a smoking Ripple and standout Easy Wind, generally clear sound despite a few minor glitches.
ai_review.review: The show is widely praised for its tight playing and enthusiastic vibe – highlights include an almost perfect Ripple and one of the best Easy Wind performances ever. The soundboard source delivers good overall clarity, though some listeners note a brief issue with the Ripple segment. Together they make this recording a solid representation of that pivotal 1971 run.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is 4.3★; most comments celebrate the performance and sound quality, with only isolated complaints about a Ripple glitch.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and balanced soundboard mix; a few reviewers mention a glitch or muffled segment on Ripple but overall the audio is listenable and well‑preserved.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert flows with high enthusiasm throughout, marking a key transitional period for the band (first show without Mickey) and keeping the energy consistently high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Seen bobbing on stage and delivering solid guitar work; no major complaints.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted spinning his cord and providing strong, “bomb‑like” bass foundation.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pig’s keyboard/harmonica saved a flub in Easy Wind, contributing to the standout performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: First show after Mickey's departure; drums were still on stage but absent, yet the band adapted quickly.
